items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: I'm going to make some sort of attempt to get Chuck to write something for the band.

ctx.x: Yeah, he's been learning a lot, apparently. And Ed got tremendous assistance from the experience in your band, no question about it. He talked about it.

Well, I'll tell you, my next -- I have no idea whether it could come to pass or not, but I'm going to make some sort of attempt to get Chuck to write something for the band. It doesn't have to be a serious piece, it could be anything he wants to write.
